items.title: CloudOrbit + DataOrbit launch Saturday October 31
items.body:
Two apps, one day. **CloudOrbit** (AWS session manager) and **DataOrbit** (DynamoDB GUI) both go live on **Saturday October 31, 2026**.

- CloudOrbit: AWS SSO, EKS, kubeconfig auto-update, works behind Cloudflare
- DataOrbit: live streams, cross-table joins, query builder with GSI support

Both are free, native Rust, open source.

items.title: Advertise with SlothLabs
items.body: Reach thousands of macOS developers, AWS engineers, and Kubernetes users. Sponsored placements appear in every Orbit app's news tab and are clearly labelled.
